reviews.text: Works very well. It helped me go to sleep faster than normal and woke up very well rested. I love how it doesn’t keep playing different sounds after the one you chose is done.

OMG. This app is such a lifesaver! It really helps my daughter get to sleep faster. It also calms her down from stressful situations. It has been such a game changer for us. She used to get to sleep in 2-4 hours, but now it’s 1-2 hours. This app is so helpful and the games are stimulating and helps with meltdowns which even teens have. I would so recommend.
